_comment: Staff accounts by role. Lowercase emails. A role applies only after the person signs in with this address AND the address is verified by Firebase Auth (Google sign-in or the e-mail link). Listing an address never creates an account. After editing run `npm run rules:build`, deploy the Firestore rules and the site. Extra librarians/deputies/directors can also be assigned on /admin/settings (roles/{email}); tech_admin is granted only here.
